sketch.name: TerminalInventoryTanks
sketch.description: An ethanol terminal inventory widget: one tank per terminal showing its fill level against low and high alarm lines, with barrels on hand, days of cover and today's net flow, plus fleet-wide totals.

props.name: unit
props.description: Shows quantities in barrels or gallons (levels are given in barrels).

props.name: showAlarms
props.description: Draws the low and high alarm lines in each tank.

props.name: tanks
props.description: Tanks: { id, terminal, capacity (bbl), level (bbl), low (%), high (%), daysCover, netFlow (bbl/day, receipts minus liftings) }.

sketch.notes: Simple control (no designer-edited items): tanks are data rows, levels in barrels (gal = bbl x 42). A tank is in alarm when its fill % is at or under low (red, LOW badge) or at or over high (amber, HIGH badge); otherwise sky. Totals: on hand, utilization (on hand / capacity), average days of cover, alarm count. Net flow: receipts minus liftings per day, green up / amber down. Tanks drawn as native widgets (vessel, liquid, alarm marks). Colours from the GridKrafter palette (sky, amber, red, green, violet). Meant for a GridBoard card about 7 columns x 5 rows.
